description: This course introduces computing students to how modern computing systems are designed, deployed, and applied across real-world industries. Through industry seminars and field visits—facilitated by industry leaders and practitioners—students explore domains such as digital platforms, enterprise and financial systems, public sector infrastructure, and applications in healthcare and logistics, including data- and AI-enabled systems. The course emphasizes systems thinking, problem formulation and trade-off evaluation in real-world contexts. Students are also introduced to computing roles and career pathways, and develop self-directed learning skills through guided activities and reflection.
title: Industry Seminar for Computing
